plain_language: The model assigned 73.8% estimated fraud risk (High). The strongest factors increasing the score were incident_severity_Major Damage, months_as_customer, policy_annual_premium; factors lowering it included property_claim, capital-loss, insured_hobbies_chess. This is a model-based risk assessment for investigation prioritisation, not proof that fraud occurred.
note: SHAP contributions describe model associations, not causal effects or proof of fraud.
